title: Capital One Venture Card Bonus: 75K Miles + $300 Credit Welcome Offer (Last Chance)
summary: The Capital One Venture Card is offering 75,000 miles plus a $300 Capital One Travel stays credit after $4,000 spend in three months. Here's who's eligible.
content: At the moment, the $95 annual fee Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card is offering a phenomenal limited time welcome bonus, making it the ideal time to apply. I’d like to provide an update that this is the last chance to pick up the card with this offer, as it’s expected to be pulled soon. Not only is this among the best offers we’ve seen on the card, but this is also a reasonably priced travel rewards card that offers long term value, especially for everyday spending. Link: Learn more about the Capital One Venture Card What is the current Capital One Venture Card bonus? The Capital One Venture Card is currently offering a limited time, lucrative, two-part welcome offer, whereby you can earn 75,000 Capital One bonus miles, plus a $300 Capital One Travel stays credit, after spending $4,000 within the first three months. For context, Capital One miles can be redeemed for a minimum of one cent each, meaning the 75,000 miles will get you at least $750 in value. However, I value the miles at 1.7 cents each based on my latest analysis ( see my methodology here ), thanks to the value you can get by transferring the miles to travel partners. That means that to me, the 75,000 miles are worth $1,275. There are lots of great ways to redeem Capital One miles , as they can be transferred to Capital One’s roughly 20 airline and hotel partners . That’s my preferred use of them, as you can get some amazing travel experiences this way. Partners include programs like Air Canada Aeroplan, Air France-KLM Flying Blue, Qatar Airways Privilege Club, Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer, Virgin Atlantic Flying Club, and more. These are all programs that allow you to really maximize your points and get outsized value. Just to give a couple of examples of Capital One mileage redemption opportunities: You could transfer 60,000 miles to Avianca Lifemiles to book a one-way All Nippon Airways first class award from Tokyo (NRT) to Honolulu (HNL), with $80.99 in taxes & fees; that same flight would cost thousands of dollars if paying cash You could transfer 75,000 miles to Aeroplan to book a one-way SWISS business class award from Miami (MIA) to Zurich (ZRH), with $56.62 in taxes & fees; that same flight would cost thousands of dollars if paying cash Transfer Capital One miles to Lifemiles for an ANA first class award That doesn’t include the value of the $300 Capital One Travel credit, which posts upon account approval (rather than upon completing minimum spending). The idea is that this can be used for a hotel or vacation rental booking through Capital One Travel in your first cardmember year (in the first 12 months), and it’s valid across one or multiple stays. In other words, you could use it to pay virtually nothing for a $300 hotel stay. All-in-all, I’d say the Capital One Venture bonus is worth up to $1,575. There are lots of great uses of Capital One miles How do past Capital One Venture Card offers compare? By my valuation, the current Capital One Venture Card bonus is the best publicly available offer that we’ve seen in over five years, so that makes this the ideal time to apply, and I absolutely wouldn’t wait for a better offer. Quite to the contrary, when this limited time offer gets pulled, it’ll almost certainly be worse. For context, below is a history of the publicly available bonuses that we’ve seen on the Capital One Venture in recent years. Time period Bonus points offer Minimum spending Bonus offer value September 2026 – November 2026 75,000 + $300 credit $4,000 $1,575 April 2026 – September 2026 75,000 $4,000 $1,275 January 2026 – April 2026 75,000 + $250 credit $4,000 $1,525 May 2025 – January 2026 75,000 $4,000 $1,275 February 2025 – May 2025 75,000 + $250 credit $4,000 $1,525 September 2024 – February 2025 75,000 $4,000 $1,275 July 2024 – September 2024 75,000 + $250 credit $4,000 $1,525 As you can see, we’ve never seen a publicly available welcome offer of over 75,000 miles, in terms of the mileage component. We have in the past seen $250 travel credits offered along with the miles, and this time around the travel credit is bigger. So offers really don’t get better than this on the card. Who is eligible for the Capital One Venture Card bonus? When you look at the bonus terms on the Capital One Venture Card, you’ll find the following language: You are not eligible for this product if you have received a new cardmember bonus for the Capital One Venture card or the Capital One Venture X card in the past 48 months. As you can see, the card follows a 48-month rule, so you’re not eligible for the welcome bonus on this card if you’ve received a new cardmember bonus on this exact card or on the Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card ( learn more ) in the past 48 months. Other than that, eligibility is unrelated to having any other credit card, and Capital One doesn’t have many consistent restrictions when it comes to getting approved for cards. The Capital One Venture bonus follows a 48-month rule Is the Capital One Venture Card worth it? The Capital One Venture Card has a reasonable $95 annual fee, and offers a variety of perks beyond the excellent welcome bonus: The Venture Card offers 5x miles on hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars, booked through Capital One Travel, plus 2x miles on all other purchases The Venture Card has no foreign transaction fees , making it one of the best cards for everyday spending , as I value that at a 3.4% return on spending The Venture Card offers an up to $120 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit once every four years The Venture Card offers access to the Capital One Lifestyle Collection, with a $50 experience credit and other benefits with every hotel and vacation rental booking The Venture Card offers rental car coverage — for full details review the guide to benefits. Redeem Capital One miles for Qatar Airways business class Capital One Venture vs. Venture X: which is better? While the Capital One Venture Card is awesome, how does it compare to the Capital One Venture X Card, which is Capital One’s ultra premium credit card? The Venture X has a $395 annual fee, so the fee is significantly higher, but it also offers several great perks that should more than justify the annual fee. Among other things, the Venture X offers : A $300 annual credit for bookings through Capital One Travel plus 10,000 anniversary bonus miles , which to me more than justifies the $395 annual fee A Priority Pass™ membership (giving you unlimited access to 1,300+ lounges around the globe), plus unlimited access to Capital One Lounges and Capital One Landings Great travel benefits, including primary rental car coverage and cell phone protection So when it comes to the Capital One Venture vs. Venture X, personally I think the Venture X is an even better value than the Venture. However, I know some people just want to avoid higher annual fee cards in general, so for those people, the Venture could be a better option. The Venture X offers Capital One Lounge access Capital One Venture Card bonus FAQs What is the Capital One Venture Card bonus? The Capital One Venture has a limited time welcome bonus of 75,000 Capital One miles plus a $300 Capital One Travel credit after spending $4,000 within the first three months. How long is the Capital One Venture Card bonus available? While we know that the current Capital One Venture welcome bonus is limited time, the end date hasn’t yet been announced. What are the Capital One Venture Card bonus eligibility rules? The Capital One Venture Card bonus isn’t available to those who have received a bonus on the Capital One Venture or Capital One Venture X within the past 48 months. How much is the Capital One Venture Card welcome bonus worth? The 75,000 Capital One bonus miles are worth at least $750 toward travel when redeemed at one cent per mile, though can potentially be redeemed for a lot more value than that. The additional $300 Capital One Travel credit can be used toward eligible hotel and vacation rental bookings, bringing the offer’s straightforward travel value to at least $1,050 if you can fully use both benefits. When does the Capital One Venture Card three month spending period begin? The spending period for earning the welcome bonus on the Capital One Venture starts when your account is opened, rather than when you receive or activate the physical card. It’s therefore a good idea to keep track of your account opening date and give yourself some time to complete the spending requirement. Do authorized user purchases count toward the Capital One Venture Card bonus spending requirement? Yes, purchases made by authorized users on the Capital One Venture that are charged to the primary card account can contribute toward meeting the required spending amount. The bonus itself is awarded to the eligible primary cardholder. Can you get the Venture Card if you have another Capital One card? You can still get the Venture if you have another Capital One card. The only rule is that you can’t earn the bonus if you’ve received a bonus on the personal Venture or Venture X within the past 48 months. Is the Capital One Venture worth it? The Capital One Venture has a reasonable annual fee, offers a great return on spending, and has a big welcome bonus. If you’re looking for a lucrative, easy to use card, the Venture is a great contender. How do you decide on the Capital One Venture vs. Venture X? The Capital One Venture X is the premium version of the Capital One Venture. While the card has an annual fee that’s much higher, it also offers valuable perks, including credits and miles that can offset the fee, along with airport lounge access. I’d argue it’s an even better value. Bottom line The limited time Capital One Venture Card bonus currently offers 75,000 Capital One miles plus a $300 Capital One Travel credit upon completing minimum spending. This Capital One Venture bonus is significantly better than usual, so if you’re eligible for the card based on the 48-month bonus rule, I’d absolutely recommend applying. This is the last chance, as the offer is expected to be pulled soon. Anyone plan to pick up the Capital One Venture Card with this great bonus?
